# A release after a truncate names bytes the truncate already removed, and
# a fill under the truncate's settled marker is never made. A crash brings
# the truncate's marker back, since settling is not persisted.
write len=64 b=65
sync
offload
truncate off=16
release
settle pick=255
read len=64
fill
crash pick=1 off=5
read len=64
